items.q: The peak voltage of an AC supply is 325 V. What is the rms voltage?
items.qAf: Die piekspanning van ’n WS-toevoer is 325 V. Wat is die wortelgemiddelde-kwadraat-spanning?

items.q: A 60 Ω fan operates on an rms voltage of 230 V. What is its average power?
items.qAf: ’n Waaier van 60 Ω werk op ’n wortelgemiddelde-kwadraat-spanning van 230 V. Wat is sy gemiddelde drywing?

items.q: Which change would increase the maximum emf of an AC generator?
items.qAf: Watter verandering sal die maksimum EMK van ’n WS-generator verhoog?
items.explain: Faster rotation increases the rate of change of flux, so the induced emf increases. The other options all reduce the emf.
items.explainAf: Vinniger rotasie verhoog die tempo van verandering van vloed, dus neem die geïnduseerde EMK toe. Die ander opsies verlaag almal die EMK.

items.q: What is the function of the commutator in a DC motor?
items.qAf: Wat is die funksie van die kommutator in ’n GS-motor?
options: It reverses the current every half turn so the coil keeps rotating in one direction
It increases the strength of the magnetic field
optionsAf: It reverses the current every half turn so the coil keeps rotating in one direction
It increases the strength of the magnetic field
items.explain: Each half turn the commutator reverses the current in the coil, so the turning force keeps acting in the same direction.
items.explainAf: Elke halwe omwenteling keer die kommutator die stroom in die spoel om, sodat die draaikrag in dieselfde rigting aanhou werk.

items.q: The magnetic flux through a 50-turn coil changes at 0,2 Wb·s⁻¹. What is the induced emf?
items.qAf: Die magnetiese vloed deur ’n spoel van 50 windings verander teen 0,2 Wb·s⁻¹. Wat is die geïnduseerde EMK?

items.q: Lenz’s law states that the induced current:
items.qAf: Lenz se wet bepaal dat die geïnduseerde stroom:
options: opposes the change in flux that produces it
is equal to the applied voltage
optionsAf: opposes the change in flux that produces it
is equal to the applied voltage
items.explain: The induced current always opposes the change that causes it, which is a consequence of conservation of energy.
items.explainAf: Die geïnduseerde stroom werk altyd die verandering teë wat dit veroorsaak, as gevolg van behoud van energie.

items.q: A device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy.
items.qAf: ’n Toestel wat elektriese energie in meganiese energie omsit.

items.q: The part of a DC motor that reverses the current in the coil every half turn.
items.qAf: Die deel van ’n GS-motor wat die stroom in die spoel elke halwe draai omkeer.

items.q: The parts of an AC generator that keep contact with the rotating coil without reversing the current.
items.qAf: Die dele van ’n WS-generator wat kontak met die draaiende spoel behou sonder om die stroom om te keer.

items.q: The value of AC that gives the same heating effect as a DC of that value.
items.qAf: Die waarde van WS wat dieselfde verhittingseffek gee as ’n GS van daardie waarde.

items.q: AC is used for national power distribution because its voltage can easily be changed with transformers.
items.qAf: WS word vir nasionale kragverspreiding gebruik omdat sy spanning maklik met transformators verander kan word.
items.explain: True. Transformers only work with AC.
items.explainAf: Waar. Transformators werk net met WS.

items.qAf: Die piekspanning van ’n WS-toevoer is 340 V. Bereken die wgk-spanning. Rond af tot die naaste heelgetal.
